name: awesome-readme-skill
description: A plugin that adds the awesome-readme skill for writing README files that are checked against the code.

plugins.name: awesome-readme
plugins.description: Writes or rewrites a project README in six checked stages (research, demo images, draft, render check, fact-check, pull request), and can also check an existing README against the code or refresh it after the code changed; use it when a README is missing, weak, out of date or needs screenshots, a demo GIF, Mermaid diagrams or a layout tree.
